title: lycopodium scariosum var. holtonii
intro: Lycopodium scariosum var. holtonii, commonly known as Lycopodium holtonii, is a species of club moss that belongs to the Lycopodiaceae family. It is a small, evergreen plant with needle-like leaves that is native to tropical regions. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic actions, helping to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents present in Lycopodium holtonii include alkaloids, which have been found to possess therapeutic properties, although more research is needed to fully understand its potential health benefits.
